import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import verify as V
from protocol import validate, loads

def run(req, expect='ok'):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-B','submission/main.py'],
                     input=json.dumps(req,separators=(',',':')).encode(),capture_output=True)
    out=p.stdout.decode().strip()
    if p.returncode!=0:
        print('NONZERO', p.stderr.decode()[:2000]); return None
    parsed=loads(out) if out else None
    if expect=='ok':
        if parsed=={'error':'invalid_request'}:
            print('WRONGLY REJECTED:', json.dumps(req)[:600]); return None
        V.verify(req,parsed,validate)
    else:
        if parsed!={'error':'invalid_request'}:
            print('WRONGLY ACCEPTED:', json.dumps(req)[:400], out[:200])
    return parsed
